The page's Current Series card still advertises the WPT Fall Festival of Oct 28 - Nov 15, 2026 (a stale promo on 2026-11-17, flagged F115). Street address from the Clark County licensing record 1000389.RES-001.

rows.name: Wynn Las Vegas
rows.poker_room: Wynn Las Vegas poker room, located in Encore at Wynn Las Vegas
rows.address: 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. S., Las Vegas, NV 89109
rows.note: Official tournament terms place the poker room in Encore. The official poker page links the WPT, Wynn Signature Series and daily tournament schedules, structures and results. Registration opening time: the official Wynn daily tournament terms and conditions state "Registration for each Event will open four (4) hours prior to the scheduled start of play", so a 12 p.m. daily event opens registration at 8 a.m. That opening time is printed only in the Wynn daily tournament terms; the WPT and Signature Series schedule PDFs print a registration CLOSE time per event but no opening time.

rows.name: ARIA Resort & Casino

The page says the Daily Tournaments run "as scheduled" but publishes no schedule, buy-in or structure, and tells guests to call the room or follow @ARIAPoker. No ARIA tournament row is listed because no official schedule or structure sheet was read.

rows.name: Bellagio
rows.poker_room: Bellagio poker room, northside of the casino next to the Sportsbook (official poker page)
rows.note: Official Bellagio poker page (read 2026-11-17) links three weekly tournament flyers. None prints a calendar date, so no dated row is listed. Friday $600 NLH, 11:00 a.m.: $510 prize pool, $50 house fee, $40 optional staff gratuity; rule 3 says players "may buy-in and re-enter through the end of level 8", so it is a re-entry event and not single entry. Saturday, 11:00 a.m.: the flyer heading says a $1,100 buy-in, the page label and file name say $1,000, and rule 7 refers to a "$600 Buy-in"; flight rules say each flight plays until the money. Its entry rule is not confirmed. Sunday $400 H.O.R.S.E., 11:00 a.m.: $340 prize pool, $35 house fee, $25 optional gratuity; rule 5 says "buy-in and re-enter through the end of level 8", so it is not single entry. The page notice "Tournament play will resume on Saturday, July 26" does not match the calendar: July 26, 2026 is a Sunday. On 2026-11-17 all three structure PDFs were read in full, so each format is published as an undated weekly row in the daily feed with its printed clauses quoted: Friday $600 (re-entry through level 8; $510/$50/$40 split), Saturday (four flights 1A-1D, a combined Day 2, "at least $50,000" combined prize pool, and three conflicting printed buy-ins of $1,100 / $1,000 / $600, so no entry fee is published) and Sunday $400 H.O.R.S.E. (re-entry through level 8; $340/$35/$25 split; payout about 12.5% of the field). None of the three is single entry, so none is ranked. The flyers are MGM's own asset host, linked from this page.

rows.name: Caesars Palace
rows.poker_room: The Poker Room at Caesars Palace, Appian Way promenade (16 tables per official article)
rows.address: 3570 Las Vegas Blvd South, Las Vegas, NV 89109
rows.note: Caesars Palace publishes its own daily tournament schedule: the official casino page carries a "View Schedule" link to the 2026 Daily No-Limit Texas Hold'em schedule PDF, read in full on 2026-11-17. It prints four starts (10 a.m. $100, 2 p.m. $160, 6 p.m. $100, 9 p.m. $160), each with a $1,000 guarantee, 20,000 starting chips, 20-minute levels and an optional $50 add-on at the first break; registration closes at the start of level seven and sign-ups open one hour before the scheduled start. Rule 3: "Participants may only register themselves, but may re-enter, by paying the entry fee, upon elimination within the first break of play" - so every Caesars daily is a re-entry plus add-on format and none is single entry. The room is "open 24/7 with both live-action cash games and daily tournaments" (official casino page). The four formats are published as undated rows in the daily feed, not as dated schedule rows, because the flyer prints no dates.
